a260913p1.summary: As noted by Nicolas Lellouche, who writes for the French tech website Numerama, Apple has updated its tech specs pages …
a260913p1.title: Apple says its C2 modem is used in iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro worldwide, and in overseas iPhone 18 Pro Max models; US iPhone 18 Pro Max uses a Qualcomm modem (Joe Rossignol/MacRumors)

a260913p10.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said Sunday that the “toughest dilemma” about his proposal to slow the advancement of artificial intelligence …
a260913p10.title: Dario Amodei says the "toughest dilemma" about his proposal to "pace the frontier" is what happens if China does not do the same (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)

a260913p11.summary: China will take the lead to help foster artificial-intelligence collaboration and development among developing countries …
a260913p11.title: Xi Jinping calls for a "consensus-based global AI governance framework" and says China will pioneer the establishment of a BRICS AI open-source community (Joanna Ossinger/CNBC)

a260913p2.summary: As rules about heat and lightning grow nationwide, the Uptown Dallas company is betting AI and automation can take the guesswork out of calls regarding severe weather.
a260913p2.title: Dallas-based Perry Weather, a weather monitoring software provider, raised a $110M Series C led by Silversmith Capital Partners, taking total funding to ~$131M (John Egan/Dallas Innovates)

a260913p3.summary: The Interior secretary is quietly meeting with AI hyperscalers while seeking to accommodate them on his department's land. — Copy
a260913p3.title: Sources: US Interior Secretary Doug Burgum is quietly meeting with AI hyperscalers to advance Trump's push for data centers on federal lands, despite a backlash (The Washington Sun)

a260913p4.summary: Low-profile venture capital firm Vy Capital has emerged as one of the rocket maker's largest shareholders
a260913p4.title: Filing: Vy Capital owns a 3.4% SpaceX stake; Vy is also the largest outside investor in BoringCo and Neuralink and committed $700M to Musk's Twitter acquisition (Ivan Levingston/Financial Times)

a260913p5.summary: Dario has written that we need to “pace the frontier,” and Sam has agreed. People may be surprised by my response: go ahead.
a260913p5.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are already free to "pace the frontier" and should do so for business reasons, instead of first demanding a preferred regulatory framework (David Sacks/@davidsacks)

a260913p6.summary: Also: The company prepares a retail store shake-up. — Apple's iPhone Duo will go down as one of the company's historic products …
a260913p6.title: iPhone Duo will usher foldables into the mainstream, just as iPhone did with smartphones; sources: iPhone game controllers will launch under the Beats brand (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)

a260913p7.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) said Sunday that Congress won't lead the charge on regulating AI safety.
a260913p7.title: Speaker Johnson says Congress won't lead the charge on regulating AI safety and AI companies should take responsibility to ensure the safety of their products (Donica Phifer/Axios)

a260913p8.summary: Anthropic has chosen Nasdaq for its upcoming IPO, following SpaceX's recent listing on the exchange — Nasdaq's tech IPO success continues, challenging NYSE's historical dominance in large listings.
a260913p8.title: Source: Anthropic has selected the Nasdaq for its potential IPO (Katie Roof/Business Insider)

a260913p9.summary: President denounces demands for regulation as existential fears over technology move to the centre of US politics
a260913p9.title: President Trump dismisses calls for an AI slowdown, saying "you have a lot of negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up" (Myles McCormick/Financial Times)
